decision_required: None for the measured footprint or terminal launch model. The residual network entitlement is documented as an OS-level WebKit prerequisite; it is not a grant to rendered documents.
distribution_gap: None for the experiment's CLI launch model: direct terminal execution is sufficient. Developer ID signing and notarization would be required only for normal end-user distribution.
fidelity_gap: The unchanged card fixture references an external HTTPS emblem. The renderer intentionally does not fetch arbitrary remote resources; only explicit digest-bound resources are served. This is a known policy limitation, not a host-isolation failure.

network_policy.renderer_documents: No arbitrary document network. JavaScript, external subresources, redirects, and non-stcli-probe navigations are denied.
network_policy.approved_assets: Verified/content-addressed asset bytes are supplied by the trusted controller and served to the document over the local stcli-probe:// scheme; WebKit does not fetch their original URLs.
network_policy.broker_scope: ADR 0010 Brokered HTTPS Egress covers deliberate Extension fetch and secondary-inference/provider calls. Rich-content renderer documents do not receive that capability or direct web fetches.
network_policy.os_residual: App Sandbox requires com.apple.security.network.client for WKWebView; the helper retains process-level outbound capability even while the document layer is denied network access.

verdict: functionally viable experiment; terminal launch and measured footprint accepted; retain text fallback until production integration is separately approved
